g.text: test-workflow — Risk-Aware Verification and Test Quality Gate
Read requirement / Slice acceptance criteria / changed behavior
Complex input space or strong invariant?
Real URL / proxy / TLS / cookie / header / cache checks
Real entrypoint / config / client policy risk?
Failure/status/exception occurrence alone is not PASS.
Real boundary behavior must use real or production-like entrypoints.
FAIL then retry PASS without a verified external cause is flaky, not PASS.
